Philly Reads Philly is a free book club for anyone who loves reading about this city, hosted by Kelly Braun of At My House and journalist Kiley Bense. Each month, we pick a book set in Philadelphia or written by a Philly-based author.
This month, we're discussing Such a Fun Age by Kiley Reid, a Philadelphia-based author.
